description: Work out the Social Security and Medicare tax on one wage payment, for the employee and the employer, using the rates and the Social Security wage base you send. Send the wages for this payment, the wages already paid this calendar year before it, the Social Security rate and wage base, and the Medicare rate. Get back the Social Security wages (cut at the wage base), the employee and employer Social Security and Medicare amounts, the employee-only Additional Medicare Tax once wages go over $200,000 in the year, and the totals withheld from the employee and owed by the employer. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/fica-withholding). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

additional_medicare_rate_percent.description: Additional Medicare Tax rate in percent, employee only (default 0.9, the statutory rate).

additional_medicare_threshold.description: Yearly wages above which the employer withholds Additional Medicare Tax (default 200000, the statutory withholding threshold).

label.description: Optional label for the payment, e.g. 'pay run 2026-24' (your own text, echoed; not a person's name).

medicare_rate_percent.description: Medicare rate in percent, for the employee and again for the employer, with no wage cap (the statutory rate is 1.45).

ss_rate_percent.description: Social Security (OASDI) rate in percent, for the employee and again for the employer (the statutory rate is 6.2).

ss_wage_base.description: Social Security wage base for the year in dollars: the most wages in a year that Social Security tax applies to (check the year's figure at ssa.gov).

wages.description: Wages in this payment that are subject to FICA (after pre-tax items that are exempt from FICA, such as section 125 health premiums), in dollars.

ytd_wages_before.description: FICA wages already paid to this employee by this employer in the calendar year before this payment (default 0).

name: fica_withholding
title: FICA and Medicare Withholding
